# Aleksa Belić

> Operator and investor who builds AI systems inside services businesses. Vice President at Aginsky Capital Group, running M&A and operations for a facilities services platform (~$30M pro forma revenue across 40 states, as of October 2026). Previously Venture Analyst at dlab (formerly part of SOSV). B.A. Computer Science, Lewis & Clark College.

## Selected work (figures as of October 2026)
- Built the platform's acquisition pipeline: 550+ companies sourced, 15 LOIs issued at $8–20M enterprise value, LLM automation across sourcing and diligence
- Built an in-house workforce operations platform for two operating companies, freeing ~600 admin hours a month
- Built a bid discovery agent that scans federal, state and municipal procurement portals weekly
- At dlab: 4 initial investments (80% of the fund's deal count); top one 280%+ IRR
